_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.src: I see another lost soul has found their way to The {p}!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.dst: また迷える魂が {p} に辿り着いたか！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.src: I can't say I am overwhelmed by your appearance. Here, the birth of many powerful and magical monsters take place.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.dst: 見た目には大して感心せんな。ここでは強大で魔力を帯びた魔物が数多く生まれるのだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.src: Gavel's governments can not stop Mistress Qira. I doubt you can either.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.dst: Gavel の政府でも Qira 様は止められん。お前にも無理だろう。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.src: If you want to meet her, you will have to defeat each division of her army.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.dst: あの方に会いたくば、軍の各部隊をすべて倒すことだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.src: Although powerful, she is not without honour. After every floor you complete, you will receive a token for a reward from the shop. Good luck, adventurer-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.dst: 強大なれど、あの方は礼節を欠かぬ。一層突破するごとに、店で褒美と交換できるトークンを授けよう。健闘を祈る、冒険者―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.src: Wh- Oh, Mistress, am I? My apologies...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.dst: な―主様、私がですか？失礼を…
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.src: Begin, the Thunder Division! Strike quickly and move on, for those within will warp your very mind should you stray for too long!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.dst: 始めよ、雷の部隊！素早く討ち、先へ進め。長居すれば中の者どもに心を歪められるぞ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.src: Heeheehahaaah! I see you! You humans have such easily influenced minds, but I'll settle for beating you within an inch of your life! Come through, come through!!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.dst: ひひひはははっ！見ーつけた！人間の頭ってほんと操りやすいよね、でも今回は半殺しで我慢してあげる！おいで、おいで！！！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.src: Feh, you're no fun, you little cheater! I was supposed to beat you, not the other way around!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.dst: ちぇっ、つまんないの、このズル！あたしが勝つはずだったのに、逆じゃん！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.src: I hate you so much. Just get out and talk to that idiot servant already!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.dst: 大っ嫌い。さっさと出てって、あのバカな召使いと話してよ！！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.src: You have completed the Thunder floor? How surprising. They were some of Mistress Qira's earliest successes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.dst: 雷の層を突破したと？意外だな。あれは Qira 様の最初期の成功作なのだが。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.src: I agree, Mistress. As promised, here is a Thunder Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.dst: 承知しました、主様。約束通り、Thunder Voucher だ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.src: Take it to the shop to claim your prize. It is located at the base of the Hive. The servant there will have important information for you regarding your prizes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.dst: 店へ持って行き、褒美と交換しろ。店は巣の最下層にある。そこの召使いが褒美について大事な話をするだろう。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.src: I doubt you are still worth Mistress's time, however. She has much to tend to here, as you might guess.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.dst: とはいえ、お前がまだ主様の時間に値するとは思えん。察しの通り、あの方はここで多忙なのだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.src: She made a deal with Gavel's people long ago, after they foolishly attempted to lay siege to our Hive.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.dst: かつて Gavel の者どもが愚かにも我らの巣を包囲しようとした後、あの方は彼らと盟約を結んだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.src: She could continue her unethical and possibly evil work...and in return, she would allow the people of Gavel to remain undisturbed by her.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.dst: あの方は非道で、邪悪とも言える研究を続けてよい…その代わり、Gavel の民には手を出さない、とな。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.src: Next you must tackle the Air division, featuring some of her tougher creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.dst: 次は風の部隊だ。あの方の中でも手強い創造物が揃っている。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.src: Begin, the Air Division! Fight freely with the wind, for the coming storm shall claim you for my own if you cannot spread your wings here!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.dst: 始めよ、風の部隊！風と共に自在に戦え。ここで翼を広げられねば、来たる嵐がお前を我がものとするぞ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.src: Well, nice work getting this far! Don't tell anyone, but I'm gonna pull my punches here, okay? I'm rooting for you, so let's have fun with this! Come on through!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.dst: わあ、ここまで来るなんてすごい！内緒だけど、ここは手加減してあげるね？応援してるから、楽しくやろう！さあ、どうぞ！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.src: Heehee, maybe I didn't need to hold back after all? You did really well, really well!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.dst: えへへ、手加減いらなかったかも？すっごく、すっごく良かったよ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.src: A lot of people say I'm the roughest we have to offer, so you've got this! I'm sorry you have to go talk to Yansur of all people now, though.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.dst: あたしが一番手強いってよく言われるから、もう大丈夫！でも、よりによって Yansur と話さなきゃなのは気の毒だね。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.src: Hrm, perhaps we have underestimated you. The creations of Air have defeated thousands, particularly-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.dst: ふむ、見くびっていたか。風の創造物は数千人を倒してきた、特に―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.src: ...yes. Here is the promised Air Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.dst: …はい。約束の Air Voucher だ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.dst: 店に褒美が用意してある。店の召使いとまだ話していないなら、次に行った時に話せ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.src: You still have a long way to go. It is not easy to gain an audience with Mistress Qira.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.dst: 先はまだ長い。Qira 様に謁見するのは容易ではないぞ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.src: Your next objective is to clear the Earth division. Some of the most powerful, raw creatures ever hatched.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.dst: 次の目標は地の部隊の制圧だ。かつて孵った中で最も強く、荒々しい生き物たちだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.src: Begin, the Earth Division! You must withstand both sheer force and deadly toxins! Be quick on your feet, or you will return to the dust of the earth!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.dst: 始めよ、地の部隊！圧倒的な力と猛毒に耐えよ！足を止めるな、さもなくば大地の塵に還るぞ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.src: Creatures of the earth were not enough for you... Mistress's most rawly powerful... Destroyed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.dst: 地の生き物でも足りぬとは…主様の最も荒々しく強い者たちが…滅ぼされた。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.src: Well, here is your Earth Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.dst: 店に褒美が用意してある。店の召使いとまだ話していないなら、次に行った時に話せ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.src: It is impressive to see how far you have come. Many have failed at this point.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.dst: よくぞここまで来たものだ。多くの者がここで倒れた。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.src: It is of no consequence, however, for the Water division is your next challenge. I am sure you will not succeed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.dst: だが関係ない、次の試練は水の部隊だ。お前が成功するとは思えん。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.src: Begin, the Water Division! If you will not withstand the crashing waves, the creatures that lurk within shall ensure you never emerge from the abyss!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.dst: 始めよ、水の部隊！打ち寄せる波に耐えられねば、潜む者どもがお前を深淵から二度と出さぬぞ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.src: You have been judged worthy enough to face me in combat. However, I know your strength, and I do not believe it enough to defeat me. Come forth now. Make your attempt to prove me wrong.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.dst: そなたは我と戦うに値すると判定された。だがそなたの力は知っている。我を倒すには足りぬと見る。前へ出よ。我が誤りを証明してみせよ。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.src: Seems my judgment was incorrect. In this case, however, it is refreshing to see.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.dst: 我が判定は誤りだったか。だがこの場合、清々しいものだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.src: Continue forwards, honourable human. Perhaps your intellect and respect will rub off on that insufferable Yansur.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.dst: 進め、誇り高き人間よ。そなたの知性と敬意が、あの鼻持ちならぬ Yansur に移ればよいのだが。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.src: Impossible. Not even the most tactically advanced monsters could defeat you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.dst: ありえん。最も戦術に長けた魔物でもお前を倒せぬとは。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#037.dst: …お待ちかねの Water Voucher だ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#037.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.dst: 店に褒美が用意してある。店の召使いとまだ話していないなら、次に行った時に話せ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.src: We are intrigued by your determination... But we are not worried. We do not expect you to make it past the next floor.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.dst: お前の決意には興味をそそられる…だが心配はしていない。次の層を越えられるとは思っておらん。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.src: Now you must face some of the toughest creatures of Mistress Qira's imagination!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.dst: 次は Qira 様の想像が生んだ、最も手強い生き物たちに挑むのだ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.src: You must now face the division of Fire, and it will be sure to burn you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.dst: 次は火の部隊だ。必ずやお前を焼き尽くすだろう。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.src: Begin, the Fire Division! Summon your courage, and brave the heat of the volcanoes and blow away in the breeze!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.dst: 始めよ、火の部隊！勇気を奮い、火山の熱に立ち向かえ―さもなくば風に散る灰となれ！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.src: Impressive, making it this far. I am your final test. Let us fight fairly, then. An honourable end to your challenge is only fitting, whether that be triumph or defeat. Come forward and face me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.dst: ここまで来るとは見事だ。我こそ最後の試練。ならば正々堂々と戦おう。勝利であれ敗北であれ、挑戦には誇り高き結末こそふさわしい。前へ出て我と向き合え。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.src: Defeat feels strange, after so long. You fought valiantly, and with great zeal, however. It would be a lie to say I am disappointed. Impart these traits onto Mistress's servant, if you would, and claim your final prize.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.dst: 久しく味わわなかった敗北は奇妙なものだ。だがそなたは勇敢に、熱意をもって戦った。失望したと言えば嘘になる。よければその美徳を主様の召使いにも授け、最後の褒美を受け取るがよい。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.src: All that is left is to talk to Mistress's servant, and claim your final prize. Surely he will not be as great an obstacle as I was.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.dst: 残るは主様の召使いと話し、最後の褒美を受け取ることだけだ。あの者は我ほどの障害ではあるまい。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.src: This is unprecedented. You have defeated some of the most recent and powerful creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.dst: 前代未聞だ。最新にして最強の創造物を倒すとは。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.src: Here you are then, the Fire Voucher!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.dst: 店に褒美が用意してある。店の召使いとまだ話していないなら、次に行った時に話せ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.src: This is unorthodox, as no one has made it this far. But I suppose this means that you have earned an audience with-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.dst: 異例のことだ、ここまで来た者はいないのでな。だがこれで、お前は謁見の資格を得たことに―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.src: Hah! Incredible! Mistress wishes to battle you herself! You astound me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.dst: はっ！信じられん！主様が自らお前と戦うと仰せだ！驚いたぞ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.src: Be warned, however. This will be your toughest battle yet. Mistress Qira is the most feared being in Gavel.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.dst: だが心せよ。これまでで最も過酷な戦いとなる。Qira 様は Gavel で最も恐れられる存在だ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.src: You will die...but consider it the greatest honour to die by her hand.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.dst: お前は死ぬ…だがあの方の手で死ねるのは至上の栄誉と思え。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.src: How cowardly! After defeating so many in the Hive, and receiving such praise, you've the gall to upstand Mistress's request?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.dst: なんと臆病な！巣で多くを倒し、称賛まで受けておきながら、主様の申し出を蹴るとは！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.src: I had begun to think highly of you, but after such a disgusting display-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.dst: 見直しかけていたのに、こんな醜態を見せられては―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.src: Wha...that- No, that can't possibly be correct, you are-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.dst: な…それは―いや、そんなはずはない、お前は―
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.src: ...Masterful...Have we been cooped up in this Hive so long that our army is outdated?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.dst: …見事だ…我らは巣に籠もりすぎて、軍が時代遅れになっていたのか？
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.src: To be defeated by a human of Wynn... I am not sure whether to be disappointed or amazed. Our ultimate challenge has been bested.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.dst: Wynn の人間に敗れるとは…失望すべきか、驚嘆すべきか。我らの最終試練が破られた。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.src: Here is your voucher, then. The back room in the shop will have your rewards. If you still have not talked to the servant at the shop...well. You should know by now.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.dst: では引換券だ。褒美は店の奥の部屋にある。まだ店の召使いと話していないなら…まあ。もう分かっているだろう。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.src: Mistress...if I may tell the tale? She was once called upon to help stop the decay of the forest.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.dst: 主様…この話をしてもよろしいですか？あの方はかつて、森の腐朽を止める手助けを請われた。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.src: With her boundless knowledge and magic, she surely could have cured it. But she declined.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.dst: 無限の知識と魔法があれば、きっと治せたはずだ。だがあの方は断った。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.src: She instead chose to create, obsessed with preparing for some sort of war.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.dst: 代わりに創造を選び、何かの戦争への備えに執着した。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.src: Mistress never elaborated, but it seems like she knows something we don't.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.dst: 主様は詳しく語らないが、我らの知らぬ何かをご存じのようだ。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.speaker: Yansur
